mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during confirmed inflation spikes above 2%, or CPIAUCSL does not cross the 2% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS leads to increased investor confidence and higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day forward returns when PAYEMS growth is above 0.5%, or returns are negative in >50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below trend signals weakening aggregate demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
regime_hint: early-cycle soft landing turning into contraction
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below trend for <10 consecutive months without a subsequent positive 5-day return, or 5-day returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in both RSAFS (retail sales) and HOUST (housing starts) indicates supply-side softness, predicting negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods with both proxies falling, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4%, the increased discount rate erodes equity present value, producing negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >50% of such events, or the effect is not detectable in walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE (unemployment) below 4.5% signals labor market tightness, which is associated with positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: No significant positive returns over 60 days when UNRATE remains below 4.5%, or returns are negative in >70% of such regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in GDPC1 (GDP) growth forecast followed by a rebound above historical averages predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates economic stabilization.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rebounds above -1% quarterly growth after a > -3% decline
failure_condition: Rebound in GDPC1 does not coincide with positive 20-day returns, or returns remain flat/no improvement.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in both INDPRO and GDPC1 (industrial and overall demand) suggests structural supply constraints, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during periods of dual weakness, or the interaction effect is not statistically meaningful.
